subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Estabelecer relações entre as partes do texto, tanto na produção como na leitura/escuta, considerando a construção composicional e o estilo do gênero, usando/reconhecendo adequadamente elementos e recursos coesivos diversos que contribuam para a coerência, a continuidade do texto e sua progressão temática, e organizando informações, tendo em vista as condições de produção e as relações lógico-discursivas envolvidas (causa/efeito ou consequência; tese/argumentos; problema/solução; definição/exemplos etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos e recursos coesivos que garantem continuidade textual e progressão temática
components.description_en: Identify cohesive elements and resources that ensure textual continuity and thematic progression
components.cc_component_description: Apply cohesive devices to signal the relationship between reasons and evidence in an argument

components.description_pt: Identificar a estrutura organizacional geral de um texto informativo (por exemplo, cronologia, comparação, causa/efeito, problema/solução)
components.description_en: Identify the overall organizational structure of an informational text (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution)
components.cc_component_description: Identify the overall organizational structure of an informational text (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution)

components.description_pt: Desenvolver coerência e coesão ao longo de um texto informativo
components.description_en: Develop coherence and cohesion throughout an informational text
components.cc_component_description: Develop coherence and cohesion throughout an informational text

components.description_pt: Analisar a estrutura composicional e estilo de um gênero para orientar escolhas de leitura ou escrita
components.description_en: Analyze the compositional structure and style of a genre to guide reading or writing choices
components.cc_component_description: Reference specific structural elements of a genre when writing or speaking about a literary text

components.description_pt: Organizar informações textuais conforme as condições de produção e relações lógico-discursivas envolvidas
components.description_en: Organize textual information according to the conditions of production and the logical-discursive relations involved
components.cc_component_description: Organize ideas and information into broader categories appropriate to the writing purpose

cc_matches.description: Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.

Multilingual learners will construct informational texts in language arts that
* Introduce and define topic and/or entity for audience
* __Establish objective or neutral stance__
* Add precision and details to define, describe, compare, and classify topic and/or entity
* Develop coherence and cohesion throughout text

Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.

Introduce a topic clearly, previewing what is to follow; organize ideas, concepts, and information into broader categories as appropriate to achieving purpose; include formatting (e.g., headings), graphics (e.g., charts, tables), and multimedia when useful to aiding comprehension.

Use words, phrases, and clauses as well as varied syntax to link the major sections of the text, create cohesion, and clarify the relationships between claim(s) and reasons, between reasons and evidence, and between claim(s) and counterclaims.
